comments.text: Ahem, in 1867 Toronto did not exist yet. It was Montréal and Kingston that was competing for being the capital city. Toronto was just a tiny town called Hogtown. Toronto only start growing after the artificial waterways were built to get past the dangerous rapids that started in Montréal. Before that, Montréal was a deadend boats could go no further. But the artificial waterways called canals changed everything and finally boats were able to get past Montréal and enter the Great Lakes. This is when Toronto really started growing.
